item.title: LOT-147: iPhone Duo and iPad column layouts

labels.name: moust4ki aka bybifok finding
labels.description: Found by Bybifok (GitHub moust4ki): credit them in the fix

labels.name: host: mac
labels.description: Needs the maintainer's Mac (Xcode, legacy app, live captures)

item.body:
### Summary

As an iPhone Duo or iPad user, I want two columns when unfolded and a tab rail when folded, so that the app uses the screen I have.

### Scope

Per the maintainer's Phase 5 design documentation (ROADMAP Phase 5).

- Module: App · Difficulty: difficult · Priority: high · post-MVP
- Implements: FEAT-016 (#160)
- Absorbs: FEAT-016 (Phase 5)
- Legacy sources (read-only, `origin/master`): Bybifok PR #4 (Duo workarounds, ideas only)
- Spec: `docs/features/FEAT-016.md` (feature spec, ADR 0011 §2; write it first if absent, crediting Bybifok) plus a short `docs/lots/LOT-147-*.md` pointing to it

### Depends on

- LOT-145 (#235)
- LOT-082 (#100, done)

### Blocked by

maintainer's Phase 5 design documentation (README question 5)

### Feature umbrella

- Implements FEAT-016 (#160), proposed by Bybifok (credit in the spec, PR and CREDITS.md). Other lots of this feature: none; **this lot is the last one: its PR also says `Closes #160`**.

FEAT issues (#145–#165) are umbrellas and are never claimed: claim this lot's issue; the PR says `Closes #<this issue>` and `Refs #<FEAT issue>`.

### Model

Fable → Opus (AGENTS.md §6: the reviewer is never the author model)

### Captures needed

- none known; any page state the spec needs and the fixtures lack is listed as *pending capture*, never hand-built (LESSONS 35-36)

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Matches the design document on the Duo simulator/device and iPad sizes.
- [ ] View logic lives in `@Observable @MainActor` models tested with Swift Testing in `App/SwiftHFRTests/`; each new test is shown to fail without the change.
- [ ] `xcodebuild build test` green on the iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0), and the `App build + tests` CI job green.
- [ ] UI strings in French; light, dark and Dynamic Type XL checked; no new dependency; no HFR fact without a source (legacy file:line or fixture).

### Before you start (agents and humans)

Read, in order: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/agents/REVIEW-ROUNDS.md, docs/agents/LESSONS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, App/README.md, ADR 0012, the spec of every dependency (docs/lots/), docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md for any forum fact, docs/FIXTURES.md if captures are involved. Claim with `/claim <session-id>` on this issue before writing code; PR body `Closes #<this issue>` + `Claim: <session-id>`; never guess HFR behaviour (stop and list the captures needed).
